name: Coupled Modeling of Solid Textures and Implicit Shapes
definition: A technique for texturing implicit surfaces by using similar functions for both implicit surfaces and solid textures, ensuring uniform textures that conform to any orientable 2-manifold shapes with no obvious stretch.
summary: Coupled Modeling of Solid Textures and Implicit Shapes textures implicit surfaces with uniform, stretch-free layers while guaranteeing interactivity regardless of shape complexity.
